claims.scope: For every finite shared block B, Boolean selector h and Boolean source pair with b=(g_+-g_-)/2, the nonzero selector-frequency channels C^alpha satisfy the exact energy identity sum ||C^alpha||_2^2=E[V_h p_b] and exact block-influence identity sum I_B(C^alpha)=E[V_h J_b+p_b J_h-2 O_B], hence are bounded by ||b||_2^2 and I_B(b)+I_B(h), respectively.
hypotheses: h, g_+, g_- are genuine Boolean functions on the same cube
B is any finite physical-coordinate block
all expectations and influences use the uniform physical measure
claims.parameter_dependence: exact; no dimension, block-size, depth, bias, address-count, or collision-gap factor
claims.collision_refund: 2 E sum_{alpha!=0,beta}|alpha intersect beta| h_alpha^2 b_beta^2

claims.scope: For every adaptive nonreusing physical block-restriction hierarchy with reach weights w_v, the total selector-channel block influence satisfies sum_v w_v sum_{alpha!=0} I_{B_v}(C_v^alpha) <= I(b)+I(h).
hypotheses: each physical coordinate is queried at most once on every root-to-leaf path
node reach depends only on previously revealed physical coordinates
b_v and h_v are the actual restrictions of the root functions
claims.parameter_dependence: one-use dimension-free budget; no depth or number-of-channels loss

claims.scope: The selector-channel class is universal: for every Boolean k, one fresh bit x with h=x, g_+=xk and g_-=-xk produces exactly one nonzero selector channel C^{x}=k. Therefore a universal standalone inequality sum D_B(C^alpha)<=C sum I_B(C^alpha) contains full FEI exactly.
does_not_claim: no proof or refutation of full FEI
no failure of a combined channel-plus-signed-remainder estimate
no failure of terminal-reserve or KL-associator payments

claims.scope: Dimension-free payment of the combined selector-channel entropy, signed coherent remainder and necessary source channel over arbitrary adaptive physical hierarchies.
claims.prior_obstruction: Block channel allocation is order-dependent and has 2^|B|-1 formal selector frequencies.
claims.new_status: The channel count is fully compressed at the influence level, but separating channel entropy from the signed remainder is exactly FEI-hard.
claims.next_action: Pair the scalar entropy interference associator with the exact overlap refund and test a one-sided combined channel-plus-remainder inequality.
